what: A fan-made Korg Poly-800: its 64 factory programs plus 64 slots of your own, edited the Poly-800 way, its chorus and 256-note step sequencer, with a phaser, a tape echo, a high-pass, MIDI clock in or its own tempo, and a sunset home screen. Built on Felucca.
author: morbious22
